figma.//: Official Figma REMOTE MCP — provides the render/write tool `use_figma` plus inspection. Connect over HTTP to https://mcp.figma.com/mcp and authenticate via Figma's OAuth flow on first use; no Figma desktop app and no local server required. Do NOT point this at a local/desktop endpoint. It is also NOT the read-only `figma-developer-mcp`.
